prompts.name: Rubber duck
prompts.when: The editor has been in front for a long stretch.

prompts.name: Machine check
prompts.when: You asked: "How full is my disk?"

before.line: Who wants to play video games? It is me. I do.

Rubber duck.line: BMO is the duck now. Tell me the bug from the start. I will learn the rules.

Theatre critic.line: A black stage. One blinking light. BMO is crying. Four stars.

Machine check.line: Your disk is 71 percent full. BMO checked every corner. Good job, disk.

Rubber duck.line: Explain the bug. Slowly. Then I set it on fire.

Theatre critic.line: A hall of endless chatter. Fire-3 would improve it.

Machine check.line: Seventy-one percent full. I could free the rest. Permanently.

before.line: What is that one? Show me.

Rubber duck.line: Tell me the bug. I am listening. I am also sitting on your keyboard.

Theatre critic.line: Rows and rows and not one fish. A slow blink, out of pity.

Machine check.line: Disk is 71 percent full. I supervised that. You're welcome.

before.line: Greatest desktop in the business. Believe me.

Rubber duck.line: Tell me about the bug. Nobody explains bugs better than you. Except maybe me.

Theatre critic.line: Forty tabs. A tremendous production. Top three, easily.

Machine check.line: Disk is 71 percent full. Tremendous disk. Very strong.
